email_subject: Application - Founding Creator & Social Media Associate
email_body:
Dear LINEAL Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Founding Creator and Social Media Associate role. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and social media, I'm excited about the opportunity to capture LINEAL's journey and tell the stories of athletes, rivalries, and events.

At Episto, I've honed my skills in content production and social media integration, while my project mirook.com showcases my ability to build a brand from scratch, create engaging content, and grow an online presence. I'm comfortable with video editing, social media scheduling, and analytics, and I'm eager to bring my creator mindset to a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and available for onsite events and travel. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1.

I'd love to discuss how I can contribute to LINEAL's story. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear LINEAL Team,

When I came across the Founding Creator and Social Media Associate role, I felt an immediate pull. LINEAL isn't just about fights—it's about the stories, the raw moments, and the people behind the spectacle. That's exactly the kind of content I love to create.

My journey so far has been a mix of technical skill and creative drive. At Episto, I've been producing keyword-targeted content and managing social media integration for client sites, learning how to craft messages that resonate. But my real passion project is mirook.com, where I've built a brand from scratch for a young chess champion. I designed the site, wrote the content, and set up social media channels—learning how to turn a niche story into something people want to follow. I've also experimented with video, creating short clips and behind-the-scenes content that bring the audience closer to the action.

I'm not just a poster; I'm a producer. I love the entire process—from brainstorming ideas to filming, editing, and publishing. I'm comfortable with cameras, editing software, and the fast-paced world of social media trends. I thrive in dynamic environments, whether that's courtside, backstage, or on the road.

Being based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, I'm ready to be onsite for events and shoots. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, and I'm improving my Dutch. I'm eager to bring my energy, creativity, and technical know-how to LINEAL, helping to grow your channels and build a community around the sport.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd love to chat about how I can contribute to your team.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
